source_paths: mlx_lm/prompt_lookup.py:adaptive indexed proposal policy, rolling admission, and verify-cliff planning
modifications: Rebuilt the mechanism as a distinct mlx2 batch-executor seam rather than copying the unified streaming API.
Uses APCv2 branches and mlx2 request-local samplers, logits processors, stop matching, lifecycle receipts, and qualification gates.
Verification is B1 per lane; multi-position target rows are amortized within a lane. No cross-request target batching is claimed.
Partial acceptance, stop, and length boundaries rewind and replay the exact committed input prefix before publication.
Low-acceptance requests delatch to ordinary one-token target rounds while retaining a truthful request-level PLD receipt.
Optional deferred admission measures next-token retrieval hits on ordinary target rounds; bounded rolling windows can later re-enter PLD only at a committed boundary.
Optional verify-cliff planning extends across or snaps below a configured measured plateau without inventing continuation tokens.

The host index now visits ordered occurrences newest-first, stops at the first screened non-rejected full continuation, selects the same continuation ordering without materializing every candidate, and indexes bounded retrieval segments instead of scanning their token positions.
Default PLD target and retrieval indexes are bounded to the largest configured lookback; explicit recent-prompt segment policy may tighten the source window and is reported in the route receipt.
Default-on integer counters report indexed occurrences, key lookups, visited and avoided sites, candidate checks, and rejection skips. Host timing remains confined to a standalone CPU benchmark.

performance_references.relationship: Performance motivation and experiment design only; mlx2 uses a different exact suffix-to-position index and copied no implementation code.
Reference CPU benchmark methodology; no source files copied.
Reviewed as evidence for avoiding copies and bounding host lookup work; the C++ follower-count containers do not map to mlx2 and no code was copied.
Reviewed threshold precheck as a later policy candidate only; not implemented or copied.

validation: CPU differential oracle covers target history, indexed retrieval segments, eviction, incremental observation, lookback bounds, source ordering, and rejection TTL.
Standalone synthetic host benchmark compares the integration-base bounded newest-first scan with the early-exit indexed path and records construction cost plus bounded integer receipts.

A bounded pre-integration synthetic MLX Metal smoke exercised the prompt_lookup_verify route on Device(gpu, 0), proposed and accepted two tokens, and recorded a nonzero indexed lookup hit and candidate check.

The pre-integration Metal smoke loaded no model checkpoint or server and does not validate the later origin/main integration source; it provides candidate mechanism evidence only, not performance, quality, production qualification, selection, or observed production use.
qualification: host-index optimization implemented and CPU-validated on the integrated source; a pre-integration synthetic Metal smoke is retained as candidate evidence only. Rolling admission and verify-cliff planning remain default-off, and the route remains selectable only with a matching current-source qualification receipt containing nonzero mechanism counters plus observed proposal and rollback checks
